transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I'm just... I'm so overwhelmed. I can’t shake this feeling that I’ve messed everything up at work and that everyone can see how worthless I am, like it’s all being recorded as proof.
Have you ever had a similar episode of depression before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way?

No, I’ve never felt like this before in my life. Before this all started a few months ago, my life was actually really active and normal, and I spent my free time playing softball and going to salsa classes. This is the first time I've ever experienced anything this dark and heavy.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yes, I keep thinking it would be better for everyone if I just disappeared. On my drive home from the casino, I catch myself picturing turning the wheel into the concrete barrier, or just hoping I don't wake up after my shift. It's scary because those thoughts are starting to feel more like actual plans than just passing ideas.

No history of prior episodes or manic symptoms was reported.
